topic: Myth: you need a whole bitcoin to mine
title: Myth: You Need a Whole Bitcoin to Mine
hook: Myth: you need to own a whole bitcoin to mine.

scenes.narration: Mining needs hashing hardware and electricity, not coins.
Pools hand out shares for valid proof of work and split rewards by contribution.
One satoshi is one hundred millionth of a bitcoin, so payouts can be fractions.

cta: Did you think so too? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: You don't need a whole coin to mine. Pools pay fractions in proportion to work.
